visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Heading skips a level
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The outline of this page jumps from h1 straight to h4 just to get smaller text. Screen reader users who list the headings find a hole in the outline. Fix the levels.

solution.explanation: Headings are read as an outline. A jump from h1 to h4 says there are missing sections. Choose the level by the structure of the content and use CSS for the size.

checks.label: Headings never skip a level
checks.expr: (() => { var prev = 0; return [].every.call(document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6'), function (h) { var n = +h.tagName[1]; var ok = n <= prev + 1; prev = n; return ok; }); })()

checks.label: Europe, Spain and Asia are still headings
